brief:
Doctors Without Borders has denounced Israeli authorities' decision to close two cases the organization referred for review, without opening criminal investigations into the deaths of staff members and their family members killed in attacks carried out by occupation forces, Shehab Wire reported. The organization submitted the cases following the fatal incidents during operations conducted by Israeli forces.

The closures proceeded without any criminal inquiry into the circumstances surrounding the killings. Doctors Without Borders' condemnation underscores the organization's demand for accountability in the deaths of its personnel and their relatives. The move reflects a broader pattern of case dismissals that the humanitarian group has challenged in previous statements regarding incidents in Palestinian territories.

title: Doctors Without Borders condemns Israeli closure of killed staff cases
